UEWCA-Empowerment of Women and Girls,Fight AgainstFGM & Other HTPs, 2013-2016

description.narrative: The project is collaboration with local CSOs in the area of women economic empowerment (WEE), fight against FGM,GBV, HTPs, Girls Education, and Anti-human trafficking. It is executed through umbrella modality. Currently it provides funding to 12 sub-grantees implementing the project at grassroots level.
Unionen av etiopiska kvinnor allmännyttig förening är en paraplyorganisation för CSO arbetar på kvinnlig könsstympning, HTPS och GBV

The Embassy of Sweden and Union of Ethiopian Women Charitable Associations (UEWCA) have had a cooperation since 1 December 2013 and lasted until December 31, 2016, approximately for 3 years. The total budget of the cooperation amounted to SEK 10 000 000. The specific objectives of the project were: - inrease access to job opportunities - reduce FGM - increase access to education opporunities for high school girls - prevent human trafficking - increase access and ownership of residence hous for 450 displaced poor women/girls - prevent HIV/AIDS among high school students and returnees women/girls - strenghten the management and operational capacities of UEWCA.
As for the results obtained they are: -2240 women have been empowered economically. - more than 50 000 women and men have increased their awareness on HIV/AIDS, FGM, trafficking and disabilites. - 1500 high school girls were provided with school material that enabled them to complete their studies, decreased drop out and improved performance. - approximately 1000 women have improved the economic litteratcy The main target group of the intervention is young girls and/or women. UEWCA has worked in limited target areas and achived very good results towards the area and individuals.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
